name: io.github.wyre-technology/afkbot-mcp
title: AFKBot
description: MCP server for AFKBot PTO management — file, list, and cancel time-off requests.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD tenant ID hosting the AFKBot app registration

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of the app registration used to authenticate to AFKBot

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret for the AFKBot app registration

environmentVariables.name: AFKBOT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: AFKBot API base URL — defaults to the production endpoint if omitted

environmentVariables.name: AFKBOT_APP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: AFKBot Easy Auth app client ID (audience) — defaults to production

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
